WITH patient_counts AS (
    SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS examination_count
    FROM Examination
    GROUP BY ID
), shares AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        examination_count,
        examination_count * 1.0 / SUM(examination_count) OVER () AS share_of_total,
        1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM patient_counts
)
SELECT
    ID,
    examination_count,
    share_of_total,
    share_of_total - average_share AS above_average_share
FROM shares
WHERE share_of_total > average_share
ORDER BY above_average_share DESC
LIMIT 10;
